message.content:
Now I understand `do_read`. It reads packets from the input. When a packet is fully read, it calls `usbredirparser_call_type_func` which dispatches to the appropriate callback. The callbacks in the fuzzer mostly just log and free data. They don't queue write buffers (except the parser itself queues responses for certain packet types).

Let me look at `usbredirparser_call_type_func` to see which packet types cause the parser to queue write buffers.
